title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf Wall Mount Solid Brass | Mediterranean Blue | Allied Brass
short_title: Covered Toilet Paper Holder With Glass Shelf | Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade bathroom organization with a covered toilet paper holder that adds a built-in glass shelf and space-saving wall mount installation in Mediterranean Blue, which presents a deep, sophisticated blue with subtle purple undertones, evoking the rich depths of coastal waters for a bold yet refined statement. Crafted from solid brass and designed for the Waverly Place collection, this accessory helps keep essentials close at hand while the shelf provides a convenient spot for small items.

Highlights:
- Mediterranean Blue transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Solid brass construction for enduring strength
- Wall mount design helps save floor space
- Concealed screw mounting hardware for a clean, finished look

Specs:
- Collection: Waverly Place
- Style: Traditional
- Material: Brass
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Overall size: 8.75 in L x 6 in W x 4.6 in H (6 in projection)
- Weight: 5.6 lb
- Weight capacity: 250 lb
- Assembly required: No
- Included: Toilet paper holder and all installation hardware (screws: #8 x 1 1/4)
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
Multiple designer finish options available
